# print a coarse ASCII map using dominant class per 8x8 block
def cls(px):
    r,g,b = px

    if r>90 and g>60 and b<130 and r>=g and g>b+8: return 'W'
    # gray robot: near neutral
    if abs(int(r)-int(g))<20 and abs(int(g)-int(b))<20 and r>70: return 'R'

    if r>150 and g>140 and b<170 and r>=b: return 'C'

    row=''
    for x in range(0,W,8):
        block=im[y:y+8,x:x+8].reshape(-1,3).mean(0)
        row+=cls(block)
    print(f'{y:3d} {row}')
